title: SymbolTable/v1
description: A table of symbols used by a MathIR expression or a ModelInterface: each symbol has a stable logical symbol_id, a human-readable name, a role on the model (variable, parameter, constant, function, or index), an optional domain (a MathIR set expression, inline or null), and an optional unit_ref pointing at a ConstantRef constant_id. Design decision (WP-B11): the inline domain expression uses a STRUCTURAL shape (oneOf of application/const/var with op as a pattern string) rather than the full MathIR op enum, so the symbol table schema does not duplicate the allowlist; srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression enforces the allowlist against the inline tree. Canonical JSON contract: sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN/Infinity, trailing newline.

symbols.description: The declared symbols. symbol_id values SHOULD be unique within the table (validated by srl.semantic at runtime; uniqueness is not a per-schema constraint so a table can be merged before de-duplication).

symbol_id.description: Stable logical identifier referenced by {var: symbol_id} nodes in MathIR expressions. Not a content hash.

name.description: Human-readable name of the symbol (e.g. 'position', 'spring constant').

role.description: The role of the symbol in a model.

domain.description: The domain of the symbol as a MathIR set expression (inline), or null when unconstrained. The inline tree is structurally validated here and allowlist-validated by srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression.

unit_ref.description: A reference to a ConstantRef constant_id giving the unit (and its physical value), or null when the symbol is dimensionless or the unit is not yet known.

inline_expr.description: Structural shape for an inline MathIR tree. The op is a '<cd>.<name>' pattern string; the full allowlist is enforced by srl.semantic.ir.validate_expression (not duplicated here).
